name: Vision Kit 读图工具
description: 给 agent 一个真正能「看见」本地图片的工具：read_image 读取本地图片（png/jpg/jpeg/webp/gif，≤10MB），经工具结果 images 字段把图片作为多模态输入回传，视觉模型可直接看图分析——补上内置 Read 仅限文本的能力缺口。工作区内图片零提示读取；工作区外路径由宿主逐次授权。

en.name: Vision Kit
en.description: Give the agent a tool that actually sees local images: read_image reads a local image (png/jpg/jpeg/webp/gif, up to 10MB) and returns it through the tool result's images field as multimodal input, so vision-capable models can analyze it directly — closing the gap left by the text-only built-in Read. Images inside the open workspace read without prompts; paths outside fall back to per-path user grants.
en.safetyNotes: Read-only. The plugin declares no network egress, performs no writes or deletes, and executes nothing from image content. File access goes exclusively through the host's scoped fs API: workspace images per the declared glob scope, anything else requires an explicit user grant per path; the host's secret-file denylist (.env, keys, .git, etc.) always applies. Image bytes are attached to the current agent conversation as multimodal input for the configured model and are not uploaded anywhere else.

author: muzimu217

agentTools.name: read_image
agentTools.description: Read ONE local image file and attach it to the conversation as a multimodal image block, so a vision-capable model can actually see it (the built-in Read tool is text-only and cannot do this). Use it whenever the user references a screenshot, mockup, diagram, photo or any image file by path and wants the agent to look at it. Supports png, jpg, jpeg, webp and gif up to 10MB. Images inside the open workspace read without prompts; paths outside the workspace trigger a one-time user grant. Returns a short text summary plus the attached image — never echo base64 image data into your reply.

path.description: Image file path — absolute, or relative to the open workspace.
